notes: SelfTune ST4 S3d (tasks/selftune-spec.md ST4, D-j, D-m): DICE-8B (family sdar, block diffusion over 4-token blocks, 36 dense GQA layers, BF16) on the in-process CERE executor built for it (native_dev.py build --model dice-8b, executor/models/dice-8b.json) on GPU0: one session, eager (no graphs), greedy only, no speculation, prefix cache, snapshot, LoRA, research points, levers other than the defaults, grammar, tools, logprobs or images. Context is the model's max_position_embeddings (32,768). The artifact is the D-m rebuild whose tokenizer.json was converted in the pinned S2 reference image (scripts/native/dice_reference.py tokenizer); the tokenizer sidecar runs with --thinking-kwarg unset, so a request renders its chat template exactly as the S2 reference does.
